deployments_detail.use: Aiden Insight AI board observer: a non-voting AI entity that attends IHC board meetings, processing decades of business data, financials and market trends to provide real-time data analysis, risk assessment, compliance monitoring and strategic decision support. [G42 (in collaboration with Microsoft)]

Aiden Insight 2.0: the UAE's first fully sovereign, on-premise AI board observer, upgraded to deliver real-time boardroom insights (e.g. Q1 2025 analysis) with enhanced data security, redefining how the board accesses and acts on strategic information. [Aleria]

RIQ, an AI-native reinsurance platform based in ADGM, using AI and advanced analytics (including BlackRock's Aladdin technology) to improve underwriting accuracy, capacity deployment, capital efficiency and investment management. [BlackRock (Aladdin), Lunate]
deployments_detail.value: $1 billion+ initial equity capital; $10 billion target underwritten liabilities

deployments_detail.use: SAIF (Smart Artificial Intelligence Facilitator): a UAE-built sovereign AI marketplace and multilingual agent enabling global developers to access, build and deploy AI solutions, procure GPUs, AI modules and custom AI stacks via voice/text/video in 5,000+ languages. [IHC (in-house)]

Judan Financial Holding: an AI-enabled 'North Star' platform consolidating IHC's global financial services (banking, asset management) and designed for scale, built as an AI-enabled platform managing over AED 870 billion in AuM. [none]
deployments_detail.value: AED 870 billion (~$237bn) in assets under management

deployments_detail.use: IFZA and Aleria (an IHC unit) signing an MOU to jointly design and implement advanced data and AI-driven digital services, creating a framework to apply AI responsibly within free-zone and enterprise digital services. [Aleria (IHC unit), IFZA]

Ghitha Holding (IHC food & distribution subsidiary) deploying SAP Business AI alongside SAP S/4HANA to drive smarter decision-making via real-time insights, predictive tools, improved workforce planning and enhanced supply chain visibility for the food sector. Easy Lease (IHC-backed) partnering with BigBear.ai to develop and deploy AI solutions across mobility, logistics, smart infrastructure and asset management, including last-mile delivery and a platform-as-a-service for delivery operators. [BigBear.ai (with Vigilix Technology Investment)]
